currency.basis: Operating bank. Latest observed official mark is the 2019-07-04 archived official template SVG; CBR confirms the bank operating (reporting 1.01.2025; finorg status «Действует» fetched 2026-10-02). No evidence of rebrand was found; the official site is currently unreachable, so continued use is supported by consistent indirect evidence rather than a live official page.

identity.basis: Catalog record 4501 НКБ «СЛАВЯНБАНК», RU, slavbank.ru (bank's public slug; actual domain slaviabank.ru) matches АО НКБ «СЛАВЯНБАНК», Veliky Novgorod, reg. 804, OGRN 1025300000175 per CBR. The archived logo.svg is served by that bank's own site template.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official provenance chain (bank's own template file captured by the archive) plus an independent CBR registry/reporting corroboration of identity and operating status; archive is a neutral capture channel, not a second author.
uncertainties: Post-2019 continued use is not directly observable (official site unreachable); no rebrand evidence found in searches through 2025.

variant.basis: Header variant logo.svg: blue (#0a90e8) knot emblem with wordmark on transparent field. A white footer variant (logo-footer.svg) also existed; the header variant is chosen as the standalone-appropriate colored variant. Emblem region will be isolated without altering its geometry or color.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All knot interlacements, strand gaps and internal transparency of the source emblem are present in the final render on both themes; no stroke loss, clipping or artifact at 240/48/32/24 px diagnostics.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem aspect (~1.76:1) is preserved without stretching; it fits the square cell with comfortable margins at the icon area size and remains recognizable at 24-48 px on both backgrounds. The transparent standalone mark is kept per policy; no backing added.
candidate.rationale: First addition for an operating bank whose catalog record has no icon. The original official-site SVG (archived 2019-07-04 Bitrix template) is a full lockup; the header lockup's standalone knot emblem is selected unchanged, which the catalog suitability rule requires. Emblem geometry, color #0a90e8 and internal transparency are preserved byte-for-byte in path data.
candidate.role: Standalone emblem portion of the official header lockup logo.svg; the wordmark «СЛАВЯН БАНК» is separate lettering, not part of the mark.
transforms: Source selection only: original lockup SVG reduced to its emblem region by restricting the viewport to viewBox 0 0 113.9 64.688 (emblem occupies the full crop; wordmark glyph paths remain in the file but render outside the viewport). No emblem geometry, color, scale or translation change.
Inline of the single style class cls-1 (fill #0a90e8, fill-rule evenodd) as equivalent path presentation attributes; no visual change.

SVGO 4.1.0, repository svgo.config.mjs (config sha256 bound to baseCommit): 10219 -> 9792 bytes; optimized trial compared visually against the working version with rsvg-convert on both theme canvases, faithful, selected as final bytes.
candidate.variant: Blue header variant of the bank's brand knot on a transparent field; no circular official avatar of this variant was observed, so the source-backed transparent standalone emblem is kept without an added backing.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this bank, so the visible difference is absence to a rendered standalone emblem; no baseline comparison exists or is invented.

proposals.reason: Original official-site SVG of НКБ «СЛАВЯНБАНК» (Veliky Novgorod, reg. 804) retrieved from the bank's own Bitrix template via web.archive.org capture 2019-07-04: single path, viewBox 0 0 244.344 64.688, fill #0a90e8 (Celtic-knot emblem + «СЛАВЯН БАНК» wordmark). Identity of the record is confirmed (CBR: АО НКБ «СЛАВЯНБАНК», OGRN 1025300000175, operating). The asset is a full lockup; a mark-only working variant will be prepared at candidate review by selecting the emblem region of the original vector (no tracing).

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector from the bank's own website template, confirmed visually after rendering: the emblem of the operating bank's current brand period. It is a lockup; the standalone emblem region will be selected at candidate review without altering emblem geometry, color or transparency.

sources.observation: Original vector (10320 bytes, sha256 2cec92eb5490f0f7ad362f169c881f224f370b8a8f790ca6bda587eddc2e256b) served by the bank's own Bitrix template (logo.svg referenced by the archived official homepage). Rendered via rsvg-convert and visually confirmed: blue Celtic-knot emblem + «СЛАВЯН БАНК» wordmark, single path fill #0a90e8. Emblem occupies viewBox x≈0-114 of 244.344.

CBR finorg (fetched 2026-10-02): АО НКБ «СЛАВЯНБАНК», reg. 804, Veliky Novgorod, status «Действует», base license; confirms the catalog record is this operating bank. This corrects the worker's preliminary claim of a 2020 license revocation.

Archived official homepage references template SVGs logo.svg (header), logo-dev.svg, logo-footer.svg; header uses logo.svg. Live slaviabank.ru and www.slaviabank.ru failed HTTPS transfer on 2026-10-02 (site unreachable), so post-2019 official presentation is not directly observable.
CBR published reporting for 1.01.2025 under regnum 804: the bank was still operating in 2025, supporting continued use of the 2019-period brand without evidence of rebrand.
